why: No finding says the result lacks a reference point such as the total paid in. Finding 1 quotes the inputs (10,000 + 500/month) and objects that they aren't the reader's own amounts, which is about personalization. Finding 2 asks whether 'today's money' is what will actually be in the account, which is about inflation adjustment. Neither says the amount put in is missing or that the reader can't tell whether the result is good.
